name: Meetingbox
description_en:
Meetingbox connects event registration and ticketing with participant, group and event-delivery records. Its registration page describes conditional questions, multilingual forms, free or paid tickets, coordinators and guest self-service changes.

This profile is based on a substantive product page and contractual terms found after the homepage returned only an application shell. The visible booking example is a demonstration, not an observed transaction or software subscription price.
description_zh:
Meetingbox 将登记/票务与参与者、群组及现场交付记录连接，产品页介绍条件问题、多语言、免费/收费票、协调员及访客自助修改。

首页仅应用壳后，本文找到实质产品页和条款。页面订单示例是演示，不是真实交易或软件订阅价。

core_features.explanation_en: Show role-relevant questions and set capacity/deadline outcomes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按角色展示问题并设容量/截止结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Assign coordinator limits and permitted guest self-service fields.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分配协调员范围及访客可改字段。

en: Prepare conditional conference registration with bounded group coordinator access.
zh: 准备条件会议登记并限制群组协调员范围。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm contract/DPA, preview success and failure journeys, then reconcile a test booking with payment and attendee records.
steps.zh: 确认合同/DPA，预览成功/失败，再对齐测试订单、付款及参与者。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Contract-based SaaS license and individually agreed services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Contract-specific net software fees plus taxes; annual advance invoicing by default. Initial twenty-four months, three-month written termination notice, then annual renewal unless contract overrides. Custom training/extensions/services separate; amount unknown.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 合同净软件费另税，默认年预付；初24月、提前3月书面终止、后按年续，合同可另定。培训/定制/服务另计，金额未知。

sources.title: Event Registration & Ticketing | Meetingbox
sources.research_notes_en: Substantive official registration/ticketing page found despite homepage shell; conditional/multilingual/group flows, own Stripe account and permitted guest updates.

sources.title: General Terms and Conditions | Meetingbox
sources.research_notes_en: February 2026 terms: contract-specific net fees, annual advance invoicing, default twenty-four-month initial term/three-month written notice/annual renewal; no amount.

sources.title: Contact Us | Meetingbox
sources.research_notes_en: Official sales/demo contact route; no request submitted; legal/contact address labels differ and identity needs contractual confirmation.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Test every registration outcome before opening
sections.title_zh: 开放前测全部登记结果
sections.en: For an illustrative multi-day conference, define ticket eligibility, session capacity, dietary questions and which coordinator can register which guests. Test decline, full, closed, duplicate and invite-only journeys as well as successful booking. The page describes form import/export and guest updates until a deadline; confirm those preserve current event rules rather than reusing stale choices.
sections.zh: 例如多日会议，需设票资格、分会容量、饮食及协调员可登范围。成功之外还测拒绝、满额、关闭、重复及邀请，导入旧表或截止前自助修改需保当前规则而非旧选项。

sections.title_en: Separate event receipts from platform charges
sections.title_zh: 区分活动收款与平台费
sections.en: The product page says payments go through the organizer’s connected Stripe account, with tax calculation, invoices, quantity controls and temporary ticket holds. This does not establish processor fees, payout timing, refund handling or exactly-once booking behavior. A completed payment must be reconciled with the right attendee record and ticket, including interrupted or repeated checkout.
sections.zh: 产品页称收款入主办方Stripe，有税、发票、数量及临时占票，但不确立处理费、到账、退款或一次性记账。付款须对齐正确参与者/票，含中断及重复结算。

sections.title_en: Budget the contractual term and separate services
sections.title_zh: 预算合同期限及另列服务
sections.en: Terms say net fees plus tax are agreed in the contract and license services are invoiced annually in advance unless the order form says otherwise. Default initial term is twenty-four months, followed by annual renewals unless written notice is given three months before the end. Custom extensions, training and individual services require separate agreement. No actual software amount or free tier was established.
sections.zh: 条款称合同净价另税，许可默认年预付，订单可另定；初始24月，期末前三月未书面通知则按年续。定制、培训及服务另协议，未确立实际软件金额或免费层。

sections.title_en: Verify sensitive-data scope and operational support
sections.title_zh: 核敏感数据范围及运营支持
sections.en: Forms can collect travel/passport documents, so minimize fields and confirm access, deletion and the separate DPA described by the terms. The contact and footer use differing entity/address labels; confirm the contracting provider. Contract availability and certification claims are not independently tested reliability. No form, payment, coordinator, badge, export, security control or sales request was executed.
sections.zh: 表可收旅行/护照，应最小化并核访问、删除及条款所述独立DPA。联系页/页脚实体地址标签有差，需确认签约方。合同可用率及认证主张非实测可靠性；本文未测表、付款、协调员、胸牌、导出、安全或提交销售请求。

research_gaps: Original homepage shell and guessed pricing 404; substantive linked-language product/terms/contact documents read successfully.
No software amount, registration, payment, coordinator permission, support/SLA, certification, source license or self-hosting verified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
